title: Create a project structure with 'webs' and 'docs' folders.
acceptance: Has a 'webs' folder
Has a 'docs' folder

title: Create the main HTML structure in 'webs/index.html'.
acceptance: Has a 'webs/index.html' file
Contains a form with title and content inputs and a submit button
Contains a container to display saved notes
Contains a search input field
Links to 'styles.css' and 'app.js'

title: Create the CSS styles in 'webs/styles.css'.
acceptance: Has a 'webs/styles.css' file
Uses a clean, minimal layout with readable fonts
Has sufficient spacing between elements
Buttons are easy to see and click (minimum 44px height)
Uses consistent colors defined as CSS custom properties

title: Create the main application structure in 'webs/app.js'.
acceptance: Has a 'webs/app.js' file
Defines core storage functions: loadNotes, saveNotes, createNote, updateNote, deleteNote
Wires up the form submit to create a new note
Wires up the search input to filter displayed notes

title: Implement note creation with localStorage persistence.
acceptance: createNote(title, content) creates a note with id, title, content, and createdAt
saveNotes(notes) stores notes array in localStorage safely
loadNotes() returns an array (empty if no saved data)
Creating a note appends it to localStorage
Invalid saved data does not crash the app

title: Implement note display on the page.
acceptance: Notes from localStorage are displayed when the page loads
Each note shows its title and content
Notes are rendered inside the notes container
Empty state shows a message when no notes exist

title: Implement note editing functionality.
acceptance: updateNote(id, title, content) updates only the selected note
Editing a note updates its content in localStorage
The page re-renders to show the updated note
Editing a non-existent note returns null without errors

title: Implement note deletion functionality.
acceptance: deleteNote(id) removes only the selected note
Deleted notes are removed from localStorage
The page re-renders after deletion
Deleting a non-existent note returns false without errors

title: Implement note search by title or content.
acceptance: The search input filters notes by title or content
Notes matching the search query are displayed
Searching with an empty query shows all notes
Search is case-insensitive

title: Polish the interface with minimal usable design.
acceptance: The layout is clean and simple
All interactive elements have visible focus and hover states
The color scheme is consistent across the app
The app is usable without zoom on standard screen sizes
All text is readable with sufficient contrast
